# Acme knowledge (generated)

Compiled by acme-stormo from human-reviewed learnings. Do not patch this skill: it is regenerated on
every deploy. To correct something, save the corrected lesson to memory; the nightly dream turns
it into a proposal a human reviews.

- `references/agent.md`: lessons Atlas learned and a reviewer accepted.
- `references/unit.md`: lessons and policies shared across the sales unit.
- `references/group.md`: lessons and policies shared across all of Acme.
